claims.detail: Data paths avoid public endpoints and honor regional boundaries for regulated cohort processing.

findings.message: PHI-like cohort processing stays in a single Azure region with geo-redundant storage disabled for primary patient indexes.
findings.reasoningTrace: Pattern: Data residency. Evidence: policy-data-residency documents in-region storage requirements.

findings.message: Ingestion APIs reach workflow workers only through private endpoints; no public ingress on data-plane NICs.
findings.reasoningTrace: Pattern: Private connectivity. Evidence: policy-private-endpoints documents private link ingress controls.

findings.message: Azure Monitor diagnostic settings stream security logging to a locked-down Log Analytics workspace with retention aligned to policy.
findings.reasoningTrace: Pattern: Audit trail. Evidence: policy-diagnostic-logging documents diagnostic settings and Log Analytics retention.

findings.message: One vendor integration still uses username-password vault entries; roadmap cites OAuth but not timeline.
findings.reasoningTrace: Pattern: Third-party SaaS. Evidence: policy-regulatory-isolation notes residual legacy credential patterns.

reasoningTrace: Reviewed regulated data workflow for residency, private ingress, diagnostic logging, and residual third-party credential risk.
